svg.text: Work graph: the product team’s path
Breaking a high-level job into sub-jobs and steps. Red marks where the path breaks.
“I want to move my tool into development faster”
The form lives in another service
Wait for the money to be allocated
Every order is a separate request
The team solves one job but walks it through two systems: half of the steps are not about the product, they are about finding where to do that step.
